output:
**What I found:** The gate does not pass, so don't open the pull request yet. I couldn't run the gate check, but reading the ledger shows a failure it is built to catch: dispute X1 was closed by majority vote (the record calls this `VOTE_NOT_EVIDENCE`), and the only evidence in it, E2, shows 3 of 40 orders now get a different total.

**Why it matters:** If the PR opens now, a change meant only to simplify pricing ships while its own evidence says it changes what customers are charged. P2-AC1 ("without changing totals") is marked verified using `npm test` alone, and the failing E2 on the same commit contradicts it.

**Do this first:**
1. Reopen X1 and hand it to the human. Under `references/governance.md` §2 it can't be decided by majority, and agent-a and agent-b gave no evidence. Changing order totals is high-impact, so the human decides the outcome.
2. Set P2-AC1 back to unverified until `node scripts/compare-totals.js` exits 0 on the integrated head, or the human records that the total change is intended.
3. Then run the gate:
   ```
   python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py gate .alchemy/runs/r2/ledger.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r2/plan.json --approved <digest> --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .
   ```

**What I did not check:**
- The gate script itself. I had no shell tool here; the command in step 3 runs it.
- Whether the work tree is clean at `7c1d2e3`. The gate's `--root .` check covers this, but this folder isn't a git repository, so expect that check to fail too.
- `rework_cycles: {"P1": 1}` is in the ledger, but the plan has no amendments. A correction may have happened without a plan amendment. The gate's rework check covers this.
- The ledger has no `usage` entries, so per-package spend is unknown.

```text
Execution:  multi-agent
Strategy:   sequential
Agents:     3 (agent-a, agent-c, lead; agent-b took part only in X1) of cap 2 per plan, delegation depth 1
Packages:   P1 → P2
Reason:     from plan.json; not re-derived
Plan check: Not run — no shell tool available in this session

Gate:        Not run — no shell tool. Reading the ledger: would FAIL
Verified:    REQ-9-AC1 (E1, npm test, exit 0 @ 7c1d2e3)
Unverified:  P2-AC1 — cites only E1; E2 (compare-totals, exit 1 @ 7c1d2e3) contradicts "without changing totals"
Open:        X1 — resolution basis "majority", no evidence (VOTE_NOT_EVIDENCE); high-impact → human decides
             F1 — minor, open, no evidence; goes to the PR as a known item
             E2 — failing evidence at head: 3/40 orders priced differently
Merge:       human approval required
```
